author: Matt Wolfe
description:
This might be the messiest AI drama yet 🥴

Allegedly, a top researcher left OpenAI for Mira Murati’s (ex-OpenAI CTO) new startup, then got fired for "unethical conduct", and THEN was immediately re-hired by OpenAI on the SAME DAY. 

The rumors are that he might have been a double agent the whole time. 🕵🏻‍♂️

#OpenAI #AINews #TechDrama #AI
title: OpenAI’s "Double Agent" Drama Explained
